run_validation: run the ego4d or egoexo validation pipeline on a manifest directory and write errors and summary CSVs to an output directory
validate_ego4d_files: validate ego4d dataset files including video components, MP4 metadata, synchronized videos, auxiliary videos, participants, annotations, and video metadata
validate_egoexo_files: validate egoexo dataset files including pre/post surveys, captures, takes, participants, objects, video metadata, and MP4 files
validate_mp4s: validate a set of MP4 video files for consistent codec, rotation, resolution, FPS, SAR, and duration properties
summarize_errors: summarize a list of validation errors into detailed and aggregated pandas DataFrames grouped by error type and release status
